title: Hit and miss
text: This was ok. My daughter is 9 and loves LOL so it was a fun treat. A number of items that came in the Fall box are too small for her to enjoy; the bracelets, ring, Fanny pack. But she loved the tshirt, cup and tiara. So I’m not sure it’s worth the $ given she can only enjoy 50% of what came. I wish they included items that are adjustable for all ages, or vary it by age group/size past the tshirt.
label: neutral
